dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The five most prominent annuli feature irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters that provide high-contrast boundaries between the dark exterior pelage and the dark interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse solid blobs in the mid-body; high spatial density of small, irregular light-colored pixel clusters lacking gradients observed in the posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side connecting the most anterior and posterior centroids of the group.
